name: hcapp_joinKennel
description: Creates or updates a HasherKennelMap record for a target user at a kennel. Handles membership renewal, home kennel designation, following/unfollowing, notification preferences, mismanagement roles, and access flags. Returns an adHoc rowset with updated following/notification state, then delegates to hcapp_syncUserData or hcapp_syncKennelAdminData depending on whether the target is the calling user.

parameters.name: targetUserId
parameters.description: User to update. May be the calling user or another user (admin editing another member).

parameters.name: isHomeKennel
parameters.description: When 1, sets Hasher.HomeKennelId and HKM.IsHomeKennel. When 0, clears home kennel designation. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL.

parameters.name: monthsToAddToMembership
parameters.description: Months to add from today or current expiry. Sentinel: 0 normalised to NULL (no change). Magic: 9999 sets expiry to 1/1/2100 (never). Magic: -9999 clears membership (IsMember=0, ExpirationDate=NULL).

parameters.name: appAccessFlags
parameters.description: App permission bitfield. Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL. Also writes to HcWebPermissionFlags (same value).

parameters.name: mismanagementRoles
parameters.description: Sentinel: -1 normalised to NULL. When set, also updates HC.Kennel.KennelMismanagementTeam from HC3.vwMmByKennel.

parameters.name: paymentAmount
parameters.description: Accepted but never used — dead parameter.

parameters.name: kennelsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor passed to child sync SP.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync cursor passed to child sync SP.

rowsets.name: AdHocUpdate
rowsets.description: Returned on success. Current state of the HKM record after the write.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.HasherKennelMap — when no existing HKM record
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap — when HKM record exists
UPDATE HC.Hasher SET HomeKennelId — when @isHomeKennel=1 or clearing home kennel
UPDATE HC.HasherKennelMap SET IsHomeKennel=0 for all other kennels — when @isHomeKennel=1
UPDATE HC.Kennel SET KennelMismanagementTeam — when @mismanagementRoles is set (reads from HC3.vwMmByKennel)
EXEC hcapp_syncUserData or hcapp_syncKennelAdminData — depending on targetUserId vs userId

codeSmells.detail: When @mismanagementRoles is set, the SP reads from HC3.vwMmByKennel (line ~1426). This is a cross-schema dependency on a view in the old HC3 schema. In HC6, this must be resolved to a view or query in the HC6 schema.
@paymentAmount DECIMAL(12,6) is accepted but never read or used anywhere in the SP body.
9999 = set expiry to '1/1/2100' (never expires). -9999 = cancel membership (IsMember=0, ExpirationDate=NULL). These are non-obvious sentinel values not documented in parameter definitions.

codeSmells.issue: @appAccessFlags written to both AppAccessFlags and HcWebPermissionFlags
codeSmells.detail: HcWebPermissionFlags is silently updated with the same value as AppAccessFlags on both INSERT and UPDATE. Callers may not realize the web permission flags are being changed when they intend to only update app flags.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change sentinel values (9999, -9999) without updating all callers
